messages:
Maya R: quick synthesis from onboarding calls today — three repeat asks: per-route billing breakdown, faster embed refresh for live docs, and a simple rollback trigger for model rollouts. recording here for prioritization.
Juan C: same signals from Helio & Brightlane. finance wants exportable line items per route.
Priya S: can we score by impact/effort and whether it lowers renewal risk? i suggest: export = high impact / low effort; embed refresh = medium/med; rollback UI = high effort.
Sam P: i can prototype a CSV export using billing-export; per-route aggregation only. estimate ~1 day. will include a canned message CS can send to customers.
Alex K: telemetry: ~40% of new tenants hit Quotas page before first successful request — supports confusion around defaults. may be worth a tiny onboarding tip too.
onboard-bot: Onboarding session created: session-3221 by Juan C — https://redwood.internal/onboard/session/3221
Maya R: Priya — please add a "reduces renewal risk" checkbox + a short rationale column to the prioritization sheet so AMs can mark churn impact.
Priya S: done. added sample customer-quote field as well.
Sam P: mock CSV header i'll use:
customer_id,route,total_prompt_tokens,total_completion_tokens,total_tokens,period
helio-123,search,14320,8920,23240,2026-03
Sam P: sample CS note: "We've added a per-route usage export (Settings > Billing > Export). Attaching a CSV helps your finance team reconcile usage."
Maya R: plan: Sam drops mock by EOD Thursday, Priya updates sheet (completed), Alex writes a 1-paragraph webhook vs poll suggestion for embed refresh, then trial export with Helio/Nimbus/Brightlane next week.
Juan C: will paste two verbatim Helio quotes into the doc later today.
Alex K: will outline webhook fallback polling approach in the doc.
Maya R: short sync Friday 10am to review mock & pilot plan. please paste any raw quotes into the sheet so product sees context.
Juan C: :thumbsup:
